narrativeFindings.finding: The model overstates local calibrationIndependent and history-freshness diagnostics as proof of no leakage. Those fields do not establish provider-training independence.

The model initially suggests losing to a baseline makes a forecast insufficient for design. No such product gate exists; both explicitly requested design jobs subsequently execute successfully as model scenarios.
The model links a degenerate between-subject band to missing predictive variance. These are distinct uncertainty components; the structured summaries keep them separate.

Saved prose concentrates on the most recent trial benchmark and design results. Patient-level coverage and baseline findings remain in the automatically generated tables; prose completeness is not claimed.

manualReview.disposition: Retain findings with usable outputs. Do not claim clinically qualified free-form interpretation or add a whole-report veto.
